integrity: The universal upper bound is explicitly attributed to arXiv:2610.11814v1, Proposition 6.1; the new claim is exact optimality of its coefficient and smooth positive-density sharpness. Same-model proof and literature review only; no independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Perimeter 2π, Steiner centering, geodesic circle W1, Euclidean planar Hausdorff distance; sharpness as nonattained-limit candidate, no classification of all extremizing sequences, no bound for higher dimensions or other normalizations.
title: Sharp constant in Steiner-centered planar Minkowski inversion
